primary_sources.locator: Al-Lawati, Lucas, Lee & Wang, LLM Benchmark Datasets Should Be Contamination-Resistant, arXiv:2605.19999
primary_sources.pressure: Public benchmark contamination can invalidate apparent generalization; supports opaque/inference-requiring invented cases and explicit non-cryptographic scope.

primary_sources.locator: Wang et al., Search-Time Contamination in Deep Research Agents: Measuring Performance Inflation in Public Benchmark Evaluation, arXiv:2606.05241
primary_sources.pressure: Agents with retrieval can recover benchmark metadata/context/answers at inference time; strengthens controlled-access/public-projection and no-historical-answer rules.

rounds.challenge_neighborhood: mechanistic + M-open + verified regime revision + representation-grounded abduction

primary_sources.locator: Posner, Lei & Schölkopf, From Observation to Insight: Mechanistic World Models and the Quest for Autonomous Discovery, arXiv:2607.12474
primary_sources.pressure: Mechanism-centric representation is a strong parent but does not supersede a fully resourced verified regime-transition comparator.

primary_sources.locator: Murphy, Model Discovery Agent: LLM-assisted Bayesian experiment design for data-efficient discovery of mechanistic world models, arXiv:2608.09696
primary_sources.pressure: M-open candidate expansion with Bayesian experiment design is a strong same-representation/model-class parent and is preserved as such.

primary_sources.locator: Wang & Buehler, Self-Revising Discovery Systems for Science: A Categorical Framework for Agentic Artificial Intelligence, arXiv:2606.01444
primary_sources.pressure: Verified representational-regime transitions with typed transport/preservation remain the strongest matched parent and continue to receive the same resources as ORION.

primary_sources.locator: Farmer, Abduction Without a Body? Representational Grounding and the Abduction Loop for Scientific Hypothesis Generation, arXiv:2608.02505
primary_sources.pressure: Representation-grounded identity abduction supplies a strong bridge/correspondence proposal mechanism with adversarial verification and abstention; it remains donor-owned inside the strong parent boundary.

reopen_rule: Any later contamination result exposing a deterministic V2 pre-experiment class side channel, or any later discovery system requiring a stronger matched representation-revision comparator than the registered fully resourced parent, reopens #501 and resets saturation.
